extraction.Name: Ann Black
extraction.Post Office Address: Genoa, Neb. 3 years; Chamberlain, S.D. 5 years; Lipp County, S.D. 3 years
extraction.Occupation/Income: Housewife; married, living with husband and supported by him
extraction.NOTES: Application for patent in fee covering Northwest quarter of Section Three, Township Twenty-Eight, North of Range Seventy-four West of the Fifth Principal Meridian, South Dakota, containing One Hundred and fifty-nine and fifteen-hundredths acres; degree of blood: one-fourth; married; husband has 175 acres, is a citizen and has a patent in fee to his land, is a member of the Standing Rock Sioux Indians, South Dakota; no inherited land; no individual Indian money on credit; not in debt; no other occupation stated beyond housewife; land not leased; no contract to sell land; no one asked her to procure patent for disposing of land; no other trust lands remaining after application is released
